vocabulary.definition: a scientist who studies tree rings to determine past events
vocabulary.example: The dendrochronologist analyzed the tree rings to understand the forest's history.

vocabulary.definition: gradually taking over or intruding on something that belongs to someone else
vocabulary.example: The encroaching vines slowly covered the old building.

vocabulary.definition: the community of microorganisms that live in a particular environment
vocabulary.example: Studying the gut microbiome can help understand its impact on overall health.
